title: Working!!! Lord of the Takanashi

alternative_titles.ja: WORKING!!! 第14話「ロード・オブ・ザ・小鳥遊」

synopsis:
The light-hearted Working!! franchise comes to a close in this final episode of the concluding season. Will Aoi Yamada get the closure she so desperately needs with her distant mother? Will the relationship between Yachiyo Todoroki and Jun Satou continue to remain stagnant and awkward? Perhaps even Souta Takanashi and Mahiru Inami will take a step forward in deepening their eccentric friendship. And in the end, Wagnaria Restaurant might finally get a new chief!

Beautifully connected, all these events intertwine to give these characters a final ending to their stories.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

episodes_data.title: Wagnaria: No Front Line Incident
episodes_data.description: Welcome back to Wagnaria! What will happen in the lives of the employees at the family restaurant?

episodes_data.title: The Wind of Love!?
episodes_data.description: A fateful phonecall brings back a terrible person into the lives of the Takanashis.

episodes_data.title: Greatest Night Ever
episodes_data.description: Realizing that he and Yachiyo both have the same day off, Jun finally finds the courage to ask her out for drinks. Meanwhile, Yamada devises multiple plans to get Sota to pet her again.

episodes_data.title: Heart Knocker
episodes_data.description: After her night out with Jun, Yachiyo begins to question how she really feels about him. Meanwhile, with Inami being surprisingly behaved around him, Sota struggles with his own feelings.

episodes_data.title: Super Bag in the Heart
episodes_data.description: Izumi sets out to find a new lady friend for the broken-hearted Souta. However, will he agree to meet a new girl after all he has been through?

episodes_data.title: Yamada, Yama-da!
episodes_data.description: Souta struggles with the idea that Inami may have feelings for him. Meanwhile, Nazuna offers her assistance with Popura out sick, and Yamada does her best to get on Souma`s good side by prying into other people`s business.

episodes_data.title: Goodbye Yamada
episodes_data.description: Aoi runs away from home, feeling that she is not loved. Her friends try to convince her to return home which makes her think that they don`t love her either! What will Aoi do now?

episodes_data.title: Mystic Sugar
episodes_data.description: The "Yamada" family still has problems. Aoi still doesn`t acknowledge her real brother and Kiryu struggles to change that.

episodes_data.title: Dangerous Situation
episodes_data.description: Mr. Otoo brings Haruna to work so she won`t get lost again. There is something very peculiar about this stealth couple! Meanwhile, Aoi wants to know why romance between co-workers isn`t allowed at the restaurant!

episodes_data.title: That Woman Shizuka
episodes_data.description: Kozue`s self-esteem hits a new low as she and the rest of her siblings, with the exception of Nazuna, dread the return of their mother. Elsewhere, Kyoko tasks everyone with making the best parfaits.

episodes_data.title: The Love and Reminiscence of Something
episodes_data.description: Satou wants to confess his feelings to Yachiyo, and he plans to quit the restaurant if he gets his heart broken. Will he be able to be open with her?

episodes_data.title: Working Girl?
episodes_data.description: Takanashi sorts his feelings for Inami while Yachiyo and talks to Popura about her future. Also, Souma has photos.

episodes_data.title: Midday Duel
episodes_data.description: Inami is feeling nervous about dating Takanashi as she still struggles with androphobia. Meanwhile, she has a visitor.

specials_data.title: Lord of the Takanashi
specials_data.description: Inami blames herself for Takanashi`s current mindset and decides to fix it. Takanashi`s mother kidnaps him, and Inami must fight his sisters to save him.
